question_text: Describe how you diagnose a cable causing intermittent connectivity.
expected_answer: You test for movement inspect connectors and run continuity tests repeatedly

question_text: Explain how you identify crosstalk in a cable run.
expected_answer: You use a tester check pair separation and inspect routing near interference sources

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot a cable that passes continuity but fails under load.
expected_answer: You test bandwidth inspect termination quality and check for microbends

question_text: Explain how you determine whether a cable is causing packet loss.
expected_answer: You run extended ping tests check error counters and test with a certified cable

question_text: Describe how you identify poor termination.
expected_answer: You inspect pin alignment check color order and test with a certification tool

question_text: Explain how you diagnose a cable run with inconsistent PoE delivery.
expected_answer: You measure voltage drop check cable category and inspect connectors for damage

question_text: Describe how you test cable performance in a busy environment.
expected_answer: You use a certifier measure throughput and check signal integrity

question_text: Explain how you identify interference affecting a cable.
expected_answer: You inspect routing near power lines test shielding and reroute if needed

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot a cable bundle causing degradation.
expected_answer: You check bend radius inspect tension and separate cables from power sources

question_text: Explain how you verify cable compliance with installation standards.
expected_answer: You check certification results inspect routing and confirm proper termination
